subject.title: fix: cloud-worker results are lost when the box dies before reconciliation

question: Should this PR intentionally advance the state schema to v5 for a nullable additive column, accepting that rollback to a v4-only build may be blocked?
rationale: Repository policy normally keeps purely additive SQLite changes version-compatible, while the PR asserts a contrary accepted ruling; that compatibility tradeoff is product and release ownership, not a mechanical reviewer choice.

options.title: Accept the v5 rollback boundary
options.body: Confirm that protecting completed cloud-worker results is worth the explicit rollback limitation, then merge with the existing migration and recovery proof.

options.title: Keep schema version 4
options.body: Use the additive-column ensure path without advancing the primary schema version if backward rollback compatibility remains required.

recommendation.title: Accept the v5 rollback boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that protecting completed cloud-worker results is worth the explicit rollback limitation, then merge with the existing migration and recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked incident, implementation, and stated design ruling place this contributor closest to the cloud-worker recovery decision; an additional release/state owner should confirm the final tradeoff.
